stop_and_surface.banked_recommendation: Post-Phase-1 testing-improvements should add either (a) the `pytest-timeout` plugin to tools/testkit/pyproject.toml + project-wide conftest.py with a default per-test timeout (e.g., 30s for unit tests, 300s for capture-generation tests), or (b) a watchdog process killer that monitors pytest PIDs and SIGKILLs orphans after a hard deadline. The `prlimit --as` virtual-memory cap (4 GB) DID work for memory-explosion mutations but NOT for infinite-loop mutations. Conventions doc § J.3 should add a worked-example for PATH-A on numba-using sims that includes pytest-timeout-plugin invocation. mls_mpm.py mutation can then complete in a follow-up post-Phase-1 mutation run.
stop_and_surface.decision: STOP-AND-SURFACE on mls_mpm.py per conventions doc § K. Real baseline retained for sim.py (partial) + 3 small files (complete). mls_mpm.py mutation banked for post-Phase-1 testing-improvements (see landing audit § 9.3 carryover).
remediation_attempts: Attempt 1: direct mutmut auto-timeout (~10× baseline). FAILED — orphan pytest survived past timeout; manually killed after 9 min hang.
Attempt 3: direct .venv/bin/python (no `uv run`) + `timeout 60`. FAILED — pathological mutation OOM-allocated 29 GB RAM.
Attempt 4: `setsid prlimit --as=4G timeout --kill-after=10 60`. FAILED — setsid worsened orphan-reparenting.

Attempt 6 (this artifact): scope-restricted to the 3 small files without while-loops (invariants.py + reference/__init__.py + reference/shape_functions.py) — completed in ~1m45s. sim.py partial baseline (29/155 mutants) preserved from accumulated cache state.
stop_and_surface.root_cause: Process tree analysis: when mutmut's runner invokes `timeout 60 prlimit --as=4G python -m pytest ...`, the chain timeout → prlimit → python uses exec without fork at the prlimit step (replacing prlimit's PID with python's code). When a pathological mutation (e.g., `rng.uniform(-radius, radius)` → `rng.uniform(+radius, radius)` produces an empty range and an infinite `while accepted < n_particles:` loop in sim.py's `_sample_blob_particles`; or a memory-explosion mutation allocating 29 GB), the python process is reparented to PID 2643 (systemd user manager) when timeout exits. Subsequent `timeout` signals don't reach the orphan. mutmut's `subprocess.Popen.kill()` only targets its immediate child (timeout), not the orphaned grandchild (python). Result: orphan pytest processes accumulate at 100% CPU + 200MB-30GB memory until manually killed.
stop_and_surface.trigger: R15 STOP-AND-SURFACE precondition per operator Item 3 routing — orphan-pytest leakage on mls_mpm.py mutations exceeded reasonable runtime bound after 5 mutmut restart attempts (~1.7 hours total elapsed).

kill_rate_trend_across_5_proof_points.note: MPM partial baseline sits in the empirical range; mls_mpm.py completion banked for post-Phase-1 testing-improvements per § stop_and_surface.
